recommendation_issues.problem: A 6-digit code shown permanently under the projected QR and accepted as normal up to 30 s becomes the easiest remote path in Phase 2: anyone in the room can text it faster than a photo. Keep the code tied to the QR time slot, but show it only on demand on the instructor's phone for the student who cannot scan, and keep the single joint cap.

Reverse pairing needs the instructor's phone online at pairing time to approve on the server, while the plan expects that phone to work without internet (lines 241, 249). The same leak closes without that dependency: the server accepts a pairing code once, binds the projection session to the first browser that redeems it, rejects and flags a second redemption, and the code field is masked so the projector does not show it.

As a replacement for reading the full list when the head count is exceeded, 3 random names catch far less: with 10 absent among 100 records, the chance that at least one of 3 drawn names is absent is about 27%. In a 150-seat hall a given cheater is drawn about 2% of the time per session, so 'caydırılır' overstates it. Keep it as a routine spot check, not a substitute for the full reading on flagged sessions.

'Kota artışı isterim' is only available if the app is also on Google Play with its Cloud project linked in Play Console. Under GitHub-only distribution the plan has to live with 10,000 verifications per day; the corrected recommendation is in misses (line 295).

The narrower wording is still wrong: Attendix (2025) is a university student app with beacon proof and an offline queue, and Edusign (already in line 325) sells an offline NFC reader. The corrected wording is in misses (line 323).

verdict_reason: The only high-severity finding (F1) is confirmed against AOSP and the plan's own lines 194, 243, 251 and 315; no finding is refuted or unverifiable. Three findings needed corrections: F7 (the quota-increase remedy requires Google Play distribution; 'fails silently' is unsupported), F8 (quote date Aug 2025, not June 2026) and M1 (the researcher's narrower wording is refuted by Attendix and Edusign's offline NFC reader). Recommendations for F4, F5 and F6 need changes (F5's reverse pairing conflicts with the offline instructor phone). Three medium misses added; no high-severity miss remains. Spot-checked checked_ok items (StatCounter 76.99/23, Edusign 5 s, Qwickly 3 s, Moodle 15 s, Manchester and Uppsala 30 s, iClicker Bluetooth Sept 2026, Acadly 95/98, Sözcü 18 Apr 2025, BUÜ, D.Ü. Mobil, UBYS, Proliz guide, AWS and Pusher outages, iClicker exploit repo, ChaoxingSignFaker 658 stars AGPL-3.0) all held; two wording disputes (Ohio 'pahalı', 'en sık').
